jobs.title: Environmental Science Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

Kimley-Horn is looking for Environmental Science graduates with 1+ years of experience to join our Oakland, CA office! This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

Assist with the preparation of CEQA and NEPA environmental documents.
Support project teams with environmental research, data collection, and technical analyses.
Coordinate with environmental specialists, planners, engineers, and project managers.
Help prepare permit applications and regulatory agency submittals.
Conduct desktop research related to environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and project constraints.
Assist with field investigations, site visits, and environmental documentation efforts.
Support proposal development, project pursuits, and business development activities.
Maintain project files, schedules, and deliverables in accordance with Kimley-Horn standards.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams supporting infrastructure, transportation, utility, water, and energy projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Planning, Biology, Geography, Natural Resources, or a related field.
1+ year of relevant environmental consulting, planning, or internship experience.
Interest in environmental compliance, permitting, and impact assessment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
Experience with Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

Why Kimley-Horn?

At Kimley-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it— that’s why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years!

Key Benefits at Kimley-Horn

Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2-to1- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary + bonus) and additional profit-sharing contribution.
Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options.
Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half-day Fridays.
Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance-based bonuses.
Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs.
Family-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.
